DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加のご注文をお伺いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I take any additional orders?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき頼んだ焼き魚がまだ来ていません。もう一皿頼む前に、注文が入っているか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未着の焼き魚注文の有無を追加前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The grilled fish I ordered earlier hasn't arrived. Before ordering another plate, I'd like to check whether the order went through.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check that the unserved grilled fish is on the order before adding another. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お席の注文を見ます。焼き魚一皿が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your table's order. One plate of grilled fish is listed.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よかったです。隣の席には似た物が出たので、私の注文が忘れられたかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 隣席料理を見て注文忘れと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's good. The next table received something similar, so I thought my order had been forgotten.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that seeing the next table's dish made you think your order had been forgotten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お客様の焼き魚は、ただいま調理しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your grilled fish is being cooked now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、その一皿を待ちます。友達が二人来たので、取り皿を二枚追加してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 注文済一皿を待ち追加取皿二枚を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll wait for that plate. Two friends have joined me, so could I have two more sharing plates?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for the already ordered plate and request two extra sharing plates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取り皿をお持ちします。今、ほかのお料理もお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll bring the plates. Are you waiting for any other dishes at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 頼んだのは焼き魚だけです。飲み物はもう届いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未着料理は焼魚のみで飲物は受取済と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The only food I ordered was the grilled fish. The drinks have already arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the only unserved dish is the grilled fish and the drinks have arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。お待たせしていますが、できましたらこちらへお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Sorry to keep you waiting; we'll bring it here as soon as it's ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。人数が増えたので、焼き魚を食べてから足りるか相談します。今は同じ料理を追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数増加後の量は食後に判断し今は追加しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Since there are more of us, we'll discuss whether it's enough after eating the fish. I won't order more of the same dish now.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will judge the quantity after eating with the larger group and will not add more now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。それでは、取り皿をお持ちします。ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-FUJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll bring the sharing plates, then. Please make yourselves comfortable.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 引き継ぐ部品の数を、一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let's check the number of parts being handed over together.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。記録は二十四個ですが、箱を見たら二十三個しか数えられませんでした。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録二十四個に対し二十三個しか見えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please. The record says twenty-four, but I could only count twenty-three in the box.
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you can see only twenty-three parts against a record of twenty-four. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最初から数え直しましょう。どの列から数えましたか。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's count again from the beginning. Which row did you start with?

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左からです。最後の列が空いていたので、そこまでで終わりだと思いました。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左から数え最後の空列で終えた方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: From the left. The last row was empty, so I thought that was the end.
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you counted from the left and stopped at the last empty row. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この仕切りの後ろにも一個あります。位置をそろえて確認します。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's one behind this divider too. Let's line them up to check.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見えました。二十四個そろっています。足りないと記録する前に、確認できてよかったです。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 仕切り裏の一個を確認し総数一致と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: I see it. All twenty-four are here. I'm glad we checked before recording a shortage.
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Find the part behind the divider and report that the total matches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認した数を、引き継ぎ欄に書いてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter the number you've checked in the handover field.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二十四個と書きます。私が作った数ではなく、今受け取る残りの数として記入します。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取残数として引継欄へ二十四個と記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write twenty-four. I'll enter that as the number remaining that I'm receiving now, not the number I produced.
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter twenty-four in the handover field as the remaining quantity received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の作業は、担当者の説明を聞いてから始めてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait for the person in charge to explain the next task before starting.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。箱と記録の数は確認しました。次に使う部品がこの箱でよいか、作業の説明で聞きます。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量確認後に用途を担当の作業説明で確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I've checked that the box quantity matches the record. During the instructions, I'll ask whether this is the box of parts to use next.
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the quantity, say you will confirm the intended use during the task explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、説明を受ける準備をお願いします。引き継ぎの確認、お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please get ready for the explanation. Thank you for checking the handover.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 電気ケトルをお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking for an electric kettle?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。手首を大きく曲げにくいので、持った時に注ぎやすい物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手首の動かしにくさから注ぎやすいケトルを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I find it hard to bend my wrist much, so I'd like one that's easy to pour from when I hold it.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for an easy-to-pour kettle because your wrist movement is limited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示品は空の状態でお持ちいただけます。実際にお湯を入れる試用はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can hold the display models empty. We can't let you try them with hot water in them.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 空の見本で、取っ手の握り方だけ比べます。お湯が入った重さまでは分からないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 空見本では湯入り重量まで評価できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll compare only the grip on the empty models. So I can't judge their weight with hot water inside, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm that an empty model does not let you assess its weight with water inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。容量と本体の重さも、表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's right. Please also check the capacity and kettle weight on the labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小さい方は持ちやすいです。大きい方より量が少ないので、一人分を沸かす使い方に合いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小容量候補の握りやすさと一人利用の適合を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: This smaller one is easy to hold. It holds less than the large one, so it seems suitable for boiling enough for one person.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss the smaller model's comfortable grip and suitability for one-person use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 注ぎ口の向きもご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like to look at the spout's direction too?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。左手で持つので、ふたの開け方も自分の手で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 左手で持つため注口方向と蓋の開閉を試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please. I'll hold it in my left hand, so I'd also like to try opening the lid myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to check the spout direction and lid operation because you will hold it in your left hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの見本でお確かめください。台へ戻す時も、お声をかけていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please try this display model. You can also ask us when putting it back on the stand.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 開けられました。小さい方を候補にします。今日は仕様を家へ持ち帰り、置く場所も見てから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 操作できた候補の仕様を持帰り置場を確認して決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I could open it. I'll keep the smaller one as an option. Today I'll take its specifications home and decide after checking where to put it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you could operate it and will take the candidate's specifications home and check its location before deciding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞ説明をお持ちください。ご検討いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please take the information with you. Thank you for considering it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご飯は、お肉と一緒にお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Shall we bring the rice together with the meat?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私は今お願いします。友人は先に肉を食べたいので、二人分を同時に出さなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分のご飯は今友人は後でよく同時提供不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like mine now. My friend wants to eat the meat first, so you don't need to bring both servings at the same time.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you want your rice now, your friend's can be later, and simultaneous service is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、お客様のご飯を先にお持ちします。お連れ様の分は、後でご注文になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll bring your rice first. Will your companion order theirs later?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。まだ友人の分は頼まず、欲しくなった時に本人が注文します。私だけ小盛りでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人分は未注文とし自身小盛一つだけ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. We won't order theirs yet; they'll order when they want it. Just one small serving for me, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Leave your friend's rice unordered for now and order only one small serving for yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小盛りを一つですね。お飲み物も今お持ちしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: One small serving, then. May I bring your drink now too?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 水もお願いします。友人は今メニューを見ているので、飲み物まで私と同じにしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 水を頼み未決定の友人飲料は同じにしないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Water too, please. My friend is still looking at the menu, so please don't make their drink the same as mine as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Order water and ask them not to give your undecided friend the same drink automatically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お連れ様のご希望は、決まりましたら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll ask your companion what they want when they've decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人にも、ご飯はまだ注文していないと伝えます。後で二つ届くと思っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 友人へご飯未注文を知らせ二杯届く期待を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I'll also tell my friend that I haven't ordered rice for them yet. They may be expecting two servings to arrive later.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Tell your friend their rice has not been ordered and correct the expectation of two servings arriving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらが小盛りのご飯です。熱いので、お受け取りにご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here is your small serving of rice. It's hot, so please be careful when taking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 受け取りました。机の空いている所に置きます。私のご飯は届いたので、友人の注文だけ後でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 自分のご飯を受取り友人注文は後でと改めて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've got it. I'll put it in the free space on the table. My rice has arrived, so please take only my friend's order later.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Receive your rice and repeat that your friend's order will be later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。追加の際はお声がけください。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Please call us when you'd like to order more. Enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付の番号札についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is your question about the reception number ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 母の付き添いで来ました。私まで札を取ってしまいましたが、診察するのは母だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 母のみ受診なのに付き添い自身も番号札を取ったと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm here with my mother. I took a ticket for myself too, but only my mother is seeing the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that you took a number ticket as a companion even though only your mother needs a consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お母様も別の札をお取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Has your mother taken a separate ticket too?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。母は先に一枚取りました。私は呼ばれたら一緒に行くため、自分にも必要だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 母が先に別札を取り自分も同行用に必要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. She took one first. I thought I needed my own to go with her when she was called.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother took her own ticket first and you thought you needed one to accompany her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お二人の札を確認します。お母様の受付を進め、ご自身の札については受付で対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check both tickets. We'll proceed with your mother's registration and handle your ticket at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。母の札と取り替えず、私が後から取った方を渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 母札と交換せず自分の後取札を渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. I won't swap it with my mother's ticket; I'll hand over the one I took afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will hand over your later ticket without exchanging it for your mother's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 番号以外に、受付の手続きはされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Apart from taking a number, have you completed any registration steps?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだです。私の名前を書いたり、診察を申し込んだりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分名の記入や受診申込はまだしていないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Not yet. I haven't written my name or applied for a medical consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have not written your own name or requested a consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お母様のお名前で、ご本人の受付をご案内します。お母様はこちらにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll guide your mother through registration under her own name. Is she here?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 隣にいます。母の札を手元に残し、聞かれたことは母にも確認しながら付き添います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 隣の母と受付へ進み質問は本人にも確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: She's beside me. I'll keep her ticket and accompany her while checking any questions with her too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Proceed to reception with your mother beside you and say you will check questions with her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、お母様と一緒に受付へお進みください。お知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then please go to reception together with your mother. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 暮らしの案内で、お調べしたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is there anything you'd like to look up in the living guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: これから引っ越す部屋に家具が残っています。使わない机を出す方法を、住む前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 入居予定部屋の残置机の処分方法を事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's furniture left in the room I'm moving into. Before I move in, I'd like to know how to dispose of a desk I won't use.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask in advance how to dispose of a desk left in the room you plan to move into. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机はどなたの物で、どちらに置いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Who owns the desk, and where is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 前の住人の物らしく、まだその部屋にあります。大家さんは処分してよいと言いましたが、回収を頼んだとは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 前住人家具と大家の処分許可だけで回収未依頼と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: It seems to belong to the previous tenant, and it's still in that room. The landlord said I may dispose of it, but I haven't heard that collection has been arranged.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that it is the previous tenant's furniture and the landlord has only permitted disposal, not arranged collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず所有者や大家さんとの取り決めを確かめ、地域の処分方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: First check the ownership and your agreement with the landlord, then ask about the local disposal method.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 大家さんに、私が申し込むのか聞きます。まだ契約の日も決まっていないので、今の自分の住所で申し込まない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 申込担当を大家へ確認し未確定契約段階と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll ask the landlord whether I'm the one who should apply. We haven't even decided on a contract date yet, so I shouldn't apply using my current address now, should I?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm with the landlord who applies and explain that the contract is not yet settled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 申込みの条件は担当の案内で確認してください。机の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please check the application conditions with the responsible department. Do you know the desk's size?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真はありますが、寸法は測っていません。次に部屋を見る時、幅と高さを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 写真はあるが寸法未確認で次回採寸したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have a photo, but I haven't measured it. Next time I view the room, I'd like to check its width and height.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have a photo but no confirmed dimensions and want to measure it next visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 住所と家具の情報がそろえば、担当へ相談しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Once you have the address and furniture details, it will be easier to consult the department.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 分かりました。大家さんとの分担と寸法を確認してから、部屋の住所で相談先を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 分担寸法住所をそろえ地域相談先を探すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I'll check our division of responsibilities with the landlord and the dimensions, then use the room's address to find the right place to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will gather the responsibilities, dimensions, and address and find a local consultation contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、必要な情報の案内をお渡しします。お引っ越しの準備が順調に進みますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll give you guidance on the information needed. I hope your moving preparations go smoothly. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 影の大きさを変える体験をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like to try the activity that changes the size of a shadow?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。子どもと試しましたが、二人とも動かしたので、何が変わったのか分かりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二人同時操作で影の変化原因が分からなかったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I tried with my child, but we both moved things, so we couldn't tell what caused the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you could not identify the cause of the shadow change because both people moved things at once. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一人は物を持ち、もう一人は変化を見る役にしてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's have one person hold the object and the other watch the changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私は持つ役になります。子どもには、影が大きくなるか小さくなるかを見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 親を物保持役子を観察役と決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll hold it. I'll ask my child to watch whether the shadow gets larger or smaller.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Assign the parent to hold the object and the child to observe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 照明の装置には触れず、案内された範囲で体験用の物を動かしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please don't touch the lighting equipment. Move the activity object only within the area indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。光を動かすのではなく、手に持った物だけをゆっくり前へ動かします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 照明に触れず体験物のみ前へ動かすと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Instead of moving the light, I'll slowly move only the object in my hand forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the lighting untouched and move only the activity object forward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 動かす前と後の影を、見比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Compare the shadow before and after moving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 前より大きくなったと言っています。今度は同じ場所から、反対へ動かして比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 影が大きくなった観察から反方向も比較したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: My child says it became larger. Next I'd like to move it in the opposite direction from the same starting point and compare.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that the shadow grew larger and say you want to compare movement in the opposite direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 体験が終わったら、物を元の所へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: When you've finished, please return the object to its original place.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 戻しました。次に待っている人へ場所を譲ります。家でも試したくなったので、説明の見出しをメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 物を戻し順番を譲って説明見出しをメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've put it back. I'll give the next person waiting a turn. I'd like to try this at home too, so I'll note the heading of the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you returned the object, will give others a turn, and will note the explanation heading. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞ説明もご覧ください。それでは、親子で館内をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please read the explanation too. Enjoy the rest of the museum together with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お会計の前に、何か確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Would you like to check something before paying?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 夜勤の帰りで眠くて、同じパンを二つ取っていました。一つだけ買うつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 夜勤後眠気で同一パンを二つ取り一つにしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'm sleepy after my night shift and picked up two of the same bread item. I only intended to buy one.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you picked up two identical bread items while sleepy after a night shift and want only one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ会計前ですので、数量を変えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: You haven't paid yet, so we can change the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。片方を売り場へ戻す前に、どちらも未開封か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会計前に余分な商品が未開封か確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. Before putting one back in the sales area, I'll check that neither package has been opened.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will check that the extra item is unopened before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらで戻す商品をお預かりできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We can take the item you want returned here.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、一つお渡しします。棚の場所も曖昧なので、違う値札の所へ戻さずお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 棚不明のため職員へ戻す商品を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll give you one. I'm not sure where its shelf is either, so I'd rather ask you than put it back beside the wrong price label.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Hand the return item to staff because you are unsure of its shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お預かりしました。ほかの商品はこのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've taken it. Would you like the other items as they are?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 飲み物も見直します。冷たい水を買うつもりでしたが、これは炭酸入りでした。水へ替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 炭酸を水と取り違え飲物も交換したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll review the drink too. I intended to buy cold water, but this one is sparkling. I'd like to swap it for water.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook a sparkling drink for water and ask to exchange the drink too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お取り替えになるまで、お会計をお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll wait to take payment until you've exchanged it.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 水を持ってきました。パン一つと水一本でお願いします。袋は持っているので、これだけ持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: パン一つ水一本で会計を頼み持参袋使用を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I've brought water. One bread item and one bottle of water, please. I have a bag, so I'll take just these home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Ask to pay for one bread item and one bottle of water and say you will use your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりします。お仕事お疲れさまでした。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Thank you for your hard work. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの資料をお持ちになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。相談用に集めた紙を、種類ごとにクリップで留めています。相談の時は外した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 種類別クリップ留めの相談資料を外す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. I've clipped the papers I gathered for the consultation by type. Should I remove the clips during the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you need to unclip the consultation documents grouped by type. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず、どのように分けたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: First, please tell me how you grouped them.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 勤務先でもらった紙と、自分で付けた支出の記録です。仕事の紙は月の順に並べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 勤務資料と自己支出記録を分け月順にしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I've separated papers from my workplace and expense records I kept myself. The work papers are arranged by month.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you separated workplace documents from personal expense records and arranged the work papers by month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ご相談の内容に応じて確認しますので、今はその分け方を保ってお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll check them according to your consultation, so please keep them grouped that way for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分かりました。全部を一つにまとめてしまわず、どの束か分かるように机へ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 束を一つへ混ぜず分類を保って机へ置くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. I won't combine them all into one pile. I'll put them on the desk so each bundle can be identified.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve the groups and put them on the desk without mixing the bundles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 記録の原本と、控えは分けてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Have you separated the original records from the copies?

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。原本の上に「提出」と書くと汚れるので、別紙を挟んで「原本」と書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 原本へ直接書かず別紙で原本表示したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Writing ‘for submission’ on an original would mark it, so I inserted a separate sheet and wrote ‘original’ on that.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you labeled the originals using a separate sheet rather than writing on them directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は相談の受付です。提出する資料の範囲は、説明を聞いてからご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Today you're registering for a consultation. Please hear the explanation before checking which documents need to be submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、今ここで束ごと渡して終わりにせず、必要な紙を聞きます。相談が終わったら原本を数えて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 相談後に提出範囲を聞き原本を数えて持帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I won't just hand over the whole bundle here and consider it finished. I'll ask which papers are needed. After the consultation, I'll count the originals and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will ask which documents must be submitted and count and take your originals home after consulting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: それでは、資料をお持ちになって相談窓口へお進みください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SZO-HAMAMATSU-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please take your documents to the consultation desk, then. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 午後の報告は、いつもの担当者が来られますか。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will the usual person come to give the afternoon report?

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は担当の先輩が早く帰るので、私が代わりに報告したいです。伝える項目を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早退する先輩に代わり報告担当を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-02.translation: The senior coworker in charge is leaving early today, so I'd like to report in their place. Please let me check what I need to cover.
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer to report instead of a senior coworker who is leaving early. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 終わった区分と、まだ残っている区分を順に知らせてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the completed categories and the categories still remaining, in that order.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 箱の数だけでなく、区分の名前も言います。名前が読めない所が一つあるので、今、読み方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 報告区分名の読み方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll give the category names as well as the box counts. There's one name I can't read, so could you tell me how to pronounce it now?
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to read a category name for the report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この区分は「その他」と読みます。報告する前に、先輩と今の状況を合わせておいてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-05.translation: This category is read ‘sonota,’ meaning ‘other.’ Before reporting, check the current situation with your senior coworker.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その他ですね。先輩が帰る前に、どこまで終わったか一緒に見て、私のメモへ移します。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先輩と終了状況を合わせメモに移すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-06.translation: ‘Other,’ right. Before they leave, we'll check together how much is complete, and I'll copy it into my notes.
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the completed work with your senior coworker and transfer it to your notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 報告の時刻は、休憩の後です。間に何か変わったら、それも加えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-07.translation: The reporting time is after the break. If anything changes in between, please include that too.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。引き継いだ時の数と、報告直前の数を見比べて、増えた分も話します。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引継時と報告直前の変化も伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll compare the numbers at handover with those just before reporting and mention any increase too.
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will also report changes between handover and just before the report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 報告する相手は、私でよろしいです。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can give the report to me.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。休憩後にあなたへ報告します。先輩には、私が引き継いだので戻って説明しなくてよいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後の報告相手を確認し先輩へ引継完了を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll report to you after the break. I'll tell my senior coworker I've taken over, so they don't need to return to explain.
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm whom to report to after the break and tell your senior coworker the handover is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、帰る前に先輩と確認をお願いします。引き継ぎをよろしくお願いします。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-SZO-NUMAZU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check with your senior coworker before they leave. Thank you for handling the handover. Thank you for your work.
